version.changelog: 清单机制新增启动拦截: 每次kg命令先扫_working/全部未完成任务→列给用户→询问是否优先处理; 用户选是处理未完成/选否继续当前命令

llm.summary: This Obsidian note-organizer is not obviously malicious, but it can automatically change many local notes and use web searches/images from note content, so it should be reviewed before installation.

dimensions.detail: The stated KG-method Obsidian organization purpose matches reading notes, creating relationship notes, de-duplicating, and repairing note structure, but those are powerful local mutation capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill gives broad auto-trigger and non-skippable workflow instructions, including applying itself to any Obsidian note path and triggering relationship building when a subject note is merely read.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with no install spec, no code files, no required binaries, no credentials, and a clean static scan.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Vault file changes are purpose-aligned, but proactive web/image searches and remote image embedding based on note content are not clearly gated by user approval or private-note safeguards.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill creates visible local checklist files under the Obsidian working directory and reuses them across sessions; there is no evidence of background execution or credential use.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want the agent to actively reorganize your Obsidian vault. Before using it, back up the vault, prefer `kg 检查` for a dry run, review any batch checklist, and require approval before writes, deletions, web searches, or remote image embedding.

evidence.explanation: The skill tells the agent to load or trigger itself broadly for vault paths and Obsidian note access, which may affect tasks beyond an explicit `kg` organization command.
evidence.snippet: “打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill” and “路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Limit use to explicit `kg` or note-organization requests, and avoid auto-applying it to ordinary note-reading tasks.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A simple request to open or inspect an Obsidian note could cause the agent to apply this skill’s workflow unless the user is careful.

evidence.explanation: The instructions connect reading or touching a subject note to immediate relationship creation, and they explicitly allow batch create/modify/delete file operations. The checklist provides planning, but the visible instructions do not require user approval before executing those changes.
evidence.snippet: “读写拆分即关联：新建/拆分/读到/修改任何主体笔记时，立即触发 R0（搜关联→建关系）” and “任务预期产生 ≥5 个文件操作（新建/修改/删除）时，必须先建清单再动手。”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Back up the vault, run `kg 检查` first for read-only review, and require explicit user approval after any generated execution checklist before writes or deletions.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If invoked on the wrong note or keyword, the agent could create, modify, or delete multiple Obsidian files unexpectedly.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to use external search/image services and remote URL checks based on note content. This can disclose note topics or derived queries to outside providers and can leave remote image URLs embedded in private notes.
evidence.snippet: “同步图片嵌入（主动，不可跳过）… 主动搜索网络嵌入”; “搜索来源：百度图片 / Google Images / Wikipedia”; “curl -I 检查状态码”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Require confirmation before any web search or remote image embedding, use approved/local image sources where possible, and avoid this mode for sensitive private notes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note subjects may be sent to search engines or image hosts, and opening notes with remote images may contact third-party servers.

evidence.explanation: The skill intentionally persists task state in local checklist files and reads them on later runs, so stale or manually edited checklist content can influence future agent actions.
evidence.snippet: “中途中止 → 清单文件保留，下次会话恢复” and “每次 kg 命令第一步… search_files… *完成检查清单*… read_file… 用户选是 → 优先处理未完成任务”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review the `_working` checklist files before resuming tasks and delete stale checklists when they are no longer needed.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Old or altered checklist files could cause the agent to resume the wrong work or prioritize a stale task.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: Broad auto-trigger rules and read-triggered create/modify/delete workflows can turn note access into automated vault reorganization.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, privileged account access, or special system permissions are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill can use local note content for external web/image searches and keeps persistent local task state for later reuse.
